inputs.text: Owner approved the whole explicit MOZAK tool-stack proposal at 2026-10-05T18:18:33.585Z and instructed implementation through completion. Implement a shipped versioned catalog, use-case-specific MCP and skill activation, setup/readiness recommendations, source-neutral research evidence recording, tests, commits and local installation. This approval does not authorize automatic acceptance of external research, deletion of historical artifacts, publishing remote releases, or blanket third-party credential/write grants.

At revision 6b7102e905c1955289f127753b874a366500ade6, MOZAK uses source-specific hash-pinned request/runner bindings and a hard-coded companion readiness implementation. Existing adapters include arxiv, dair-ai, mcp-registry, github-tooling, hyperresearch and monokl. A managed companion catalog already ships ADHD and Notes. The new stack should replace adapter orchestration as the default while preserving legacy validation and recorded provenance.

Catalog and host-facing skill rules must make tool selection explicit per use case, distinguish missing packages from configured/connected/usable tools and write grants, report installation steps without silent execution, preserve immutable proposal-only evidence and separate acceptance, and preserve existing adapter artifacts. Test fresh onboarding, missing prerequisites, tool routing, evidence tamper refusal, and historical compatibility. Actual Zotero library access is externally blocked: local MCP handshake succeeds but no database at the configured/default path exists.
